description: Android activity class 'PickContact' demonstrating contact selection via intents, handling user interactions, and displaying contact info with Toast messages.

classes.name: PickContact
classes.description: An Android activity that allows users to pick contacts, persons, phones, or addresses, and displays the selected data.

classes.name: ResultDisplayer
classes.description: Inner class implementing OnClickListener to initiate contact content selection based on button clicks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and assigns click listeners to buttons for contact selection.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from contact selection intent, retrieves contact URI, queries contact ID, and displays info via Toast.
